context_for_next_testing_agent: Share Product Catalog feature fully implemented. Inventory page at /seller/business-tools/inventory has: (1) 'Select Products' toggle button (data-testid: selection-mode-btn) that enables checkboxes on each row, (2) 'Select All' button (data-testid: select-all-btn), (3) 'Share Product Catalog' button appears when products selected (data-testid: share-catalog-btn), (4) Share modal has 4 steps - products review with category grouping, recipient selection (buyers+suppliers with type badge), format options (PDF/Excel + show/hide price), result with download and WhatsApp share.
